subject.title: fix: macOS reports CLI-only Tailscale as not installed

question: Should this PR require a redacted after-fix capture from a real CLI-only Tailscale installation before it is merged?
rationale: The implementation is intended to correct a native settings classification, but the supplied live request only proves the daemon API response and the remaining evidence is automated test coverage rather than the changed user-visible result.

options.title: Require CLI-only settings proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted native-app screenshot, recording, terminal-plus-settings capture, or runtime log from a real CLI-only install that shows correct detection and no GUI launch action.

options.title: Accept test-only evidence
options.body: Allow the focused Swift tests and API probe to stand as sufficient evidence despite no direct CLI-only Settings capture.

recommendation.title: Require CLI-only settings proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted native-app screenshot, recording, terminal-plus-settings capture, or runtime log from a real CLI-only install that shows correct detection and no GUI launch action.

likelyOwner.reason: The assignment and follow-up implementation commit place this decision closest to the active macOS ownership path.
